name: Colombia
title: Colombia / Bogotá
subtitle: Official Policía Nacional crime counts, Bogotá focus, departmental choropleth, Colombian wires, InSight Crime group profiles

sources.name: ColombiaOpenData
sources.label: datos.gov.co · Policía Nacional (SIEDCO)
sources.detail: Monthly incident counts by municipio; published with ~1 month lag; key-free SODA API.

sources.name: ColombiaNews
sources.label: Colombian wires
sources.detail: El Tiempo Bogotá, La Silla Vacía, Indepaz RSS — headline, time and link only.

sources.name: InSightCrime
sources.label: InSight Crime · Colombia
sources.detail: Colombia tag feed + Colombia Groups profiles (title / excerpt / link).

sources.name: DefensoriaSAT
sources.label: Defensoría del Pueblo · Alertas Tempranas (SAT)
sources.detail: Early-warning alert index (number, type, municipios, key threat, date, PDF) — first two index pages polled; the alert text stays in the Defensoría PDF.

sources.name: Indepaz
sources.label: Indepaz · masacres y líderes asesinados
sources.detail: Massacre rows (date, place, victims) and killed-leader / signatory counts re-tallied from Indepaz's running posts; no names stored.

sources.name: ACLED
sources.label: ACLED conflict events
sources.detail: Needs ACLED_EMAIL + ACLED_KEY; stays NO KEY until registered.

sources.name: CII
sources.label: Country Instability Index
sources.detail: CRUCIX composite — Colombia is not in the 24-country CII set; shown for Venezuela only.

linkOuts.label: Defensoría del Pueblo · Alertas Tempranas (SAT)
linkOuts.why: Full alert PDFs and interactive fichas; CRUCIX polls only the index rows (Early Warnings panel).

linkOuts.label: SCJ Bogotá · Cifras de seguridad
linkOuts.why: ArcGIS service timed out from CRUCIX hosts; official localidad-level figures live here — the map draws official localidad polygons but has no official per-localidad values.

linkOuts.label: Medicina Legal · Forensis / datos abiertos
linkOuts.why: Annual files carry localidad_del_hecho; not a live feed.

linkOuts.label: El Espectador · Bogotá
linkOuts.why: Public RSS endpoint tested was an empty comments feed.

linkOuts.label: Indepaz · Masacres y líderes asesinados
linkOuts.why: Running massacre and killed-leader lists with names; CRUCIX shows counts and places only.

notes: Policía Nacional counts are reports (denuncias) per municipio — not localidad or barrio — and lag by about one month.
ACLED stays NO KEY until an account is registered; no conflict-event layer is drawn for Colombia in this build.
Bogotá localidad polygons are official (Datos Abiertos Bogotá / SDP); their shading is wire mentions only — no official per-localidad crime series is polled.
Defensoría SAT alerts cover whole municipios: points mark the listed municipio seats, not incident sites. Indepaz tallies are an NGO count, not an official one.
